name: JoAi: Update Product

description.en: Update an existing shop product — name, unit, tags, description, structured details, active state, or visibility. Only the fields you provide are changed.
description.de: Ein bestehendes Shop-Produkt aktualisieren — Name, Einheit, Tags, Beschreibung, strukturierte Details, Aktiv-Status oder Sichtbarkeit. Nur die angegebenen Felder werden geändert.
description.fr: Mettre à jour un produit de boutique — nom, unité, tags, description, détails structurés, état actif ou visibilité. Seuls les champs fournis sont modifiés.
description.es: Actualiza un producto de tienda — nombre, unidad, etiquetas, descripción, detalles estructurados, estado activo o visibilidad. Solo cambian los campos proporcionados.
description.it: Aggiorna un prodotto del negozio — nome, unità, tag, descrizione, dettagli strutturati, stato attivo o visibilità. Vengono modificati solo i campi forniti.
description.ro: Actualizează un produs din magazin — nume, unitate, taguri, descriere, detalii structurate, stare activă sau vizibilitate. Se schimbă doar câmpurile furnizate.

bot: Use when the user wants to change an existing product. Pass the product slug from list_products as product_id. PUT goes to /v1/products/{slug} — never the collection URL. Only include fields that change. Pass tags as [] to clear tags. Do not send price (price is on variations). To change VAT, pass taxClassId from tax-class-list. For nutrition/ingredients/specs, pass meta.details as a sections array (kind kv or text).

inputs.name: Product slug
inputs.bot: The product slug from list_products (e.g. holz-schneidebrett). Required for the PUT URL — without it the request hits /v1/products and fails.

description.fr: Libellé de l'unité (ex. pièce, kg, h)
description.es: Etiqueta de unidad (p. ej. pieza, kg, h)

inputs.name: Tags

description.en: Replacement tags, e.g. ["appetizers","mains"]. Use [] to clear all tags.
description.de: Ersatz-Tags, z.B. ["vorspeisen","hauptgerichte"]. Mit [] alle Tags entfernen.
description.fr: Tags de remplacement, ex. ["entrées","plats"]. Utilise [] pour tout effacer.
description.es: Etiquetas de reemplazo, p. ej. ["entrantes","platos"]. Usa [] para borrarlas.
description.it: Tag sostitutivi, es. ["antipasti","primi"]. Usa [] per rimuoverli.
description.ro: Taguri de înlocuire, ex. ["aperitive","feluri principale"]. Folosește [] pentru a le șterge.

inputs.bot: Replaces the full tag list. Pass [] to clear tags without changing other fields.

description.en: Whether the product is active (visible for ordering) ("true"/"false")
description.de: Ob das Produkt aktiv ist (für Bestellungen sichtbar)
description.fr: Si le produit est actif (visible pour la commande)
description.es: Si el producto está activo (visible para pedidos)
description.it: Se il prodotto è attivo (visibile per gli ordini)
description.ro: Dacă produsul este activ (vizibil pentru comenzi)

description.en: Whether the product is publicly visible ("true"/"false")
description.de: Ob das Produkt öffentlich sichtbar ist
description.fr: Si le produit est visible publiquement
description.es: Si el producto es visible públicamente
description.it: Se il prodotto è visibile pubblicamente

inputs.name: Details

description.en: Structured detail sections JSON, e.g. [{"key":"nutrition","title":"Nutrition","kind":"kv","rows":[{"label":"Energy","value":"350 kcal"}]},{"key":"ingredients","title":"Ingredients","kind":"text","text":"Flour, water"}]. Use kind "kv" for label/value rows or "text" for a block. title/text/label/value may be strings or locale maps. Pass [] to clear.
description.de: Strukturierte Detail-Abschnitte als JSON, z.B. [{"key":"nutrition","title":"Nährwerte","kind":"kv","rows":[{"label":"Energie","value":"350 kcal"}]},{"key":"ingredients","title":"Zutaten","kind":"text","text":"Mehl, Wasser"}]. kind "kv" für Label/Wert-Zeilen oder "text" für einen Block. title/text/label/value als String oder Locale-Map. Mit [] leeren.

inputs.bot: Sets meta.details on the product. Array of sections: {key, title, kind:"kv"|"text", rows?|text?}. Keys: lowercase slug [a-z][a-z0-9_-]*. Pass [] to clear all detail sections. Omit to leave unchanged.

inputs.name: Tax Class ID

description.en: Tax rate hash ID from list tax classes. Omit when not changing tax.
description.de: Steuersatz-Hash-ID aus Steuersätze auflisten. Weglassen, wenn unverändert.
description.fr: ID du taux de TVA (liste des taux). Omettre pour ne pas changer.
description.es: ID del tipo de IVA (listar tipos). Omitir para no cambiar.
description.it: ID aliquota IVA (elenca aliquote). Omettere per non cambiare.
description.ro: ID cotă TVA (listează cotele). Omite pentru a nu schimba.

inputs.bot: Hash ID from tax-class-list. Omit when not changing tax.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug of the product. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug des Produkts. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe du produit. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo del producto. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team del prodotto. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei produsului. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team the product belongs to. Omit to use the current team.
